title: Six claims of unity
prompt:
Six voices insist that contradiction and opposition are the same thing. They are not.
Here claims have ordinary two-valued Boolean meaning. Solve the conjunction below.
Submit A B C D E F as six contiguous binary digits. != is exclusive inequality, == is equivalence.

(A != B) and (C == (A and not D)) and (D == (B or E)) and (E != F) and (F == (A == C)) and (B == (not E)) and A
